description: Draw object relationships or compositions at four fidelity levels. Use it when reviewing static structure or appearance; use design_preview instead to run generated React/Vue behavior. Returns SVG or HTML with fidelity-specific structure and provenance. fidelityKind selects boxes-arrows, wireframe, review or branded-mockup. Supply exactly one object, objects set, schema/schemaRef, fixture or legacy manifest; object/context composes a screen. Object diagrams show declared relationships; schema diagrams show containment. Wireframe/review show component bindings and recorded confidence, and branded mockups use static sample data. options.brandOverlay/theme selects built tokens. These drawings do not certify usability or referential integrity. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#fidelity_preview; full schema: oods://schemas/fidelity_preview.input.json.

context.description: Context to compose for a single object in wireframe, review or branded-mockup.

fidelityKind.description: Which HTML fidelity emitter to invoke.

fixture.description: Named allow-listed Object Catalog fixture shipped in registry data; unknown names return OODS-FP-001.

manifest.description: Inline Object Catalog manifest to render — an alternative to `fixture`. See full schema for details.

object.description: Registered object. boxes-arrows draws its declared relationships; other views compose it in context.

objects.description: Explicit object set; draw only declared edges within this set. boxes-arrows only.

brandOverlay.description: Built brand for object relationship diagrams, composed wireframes, reviews, component… See full schema for details.

depth.description: Outgoing relationship depth for a single object. An explicit objects set is never expanded.

includeStyles.description: Omit HTML style blocks when false. Diagram SVG retains its explicit paint attributes.

reviewThreshold.description: Recorded confidence below this threshold is flagged in review. See full schema for details.

theme.description: Built token scope for object relationship diagrams and composed branded mockups.

variant.description: Projection-variant selector passed through to the emitter / runPreEmit()).

schema.description: Inline composed screen tree; validated as UiSchema.

schemaRef.description: Cached UiSchema from design.compose or schema load; missing/expired refs return a typed error.

name: fidelity_preview
title: Preview Fidelity
